title: Play Notes
brief: Right now the tone drones forever — nothing is triggering notes. Add a Keyboard, an ADSR envelope, and a VCA (voltage-controlled amplifier). Patch: Keyboard "Pitch" → VCO's "1V/Oct" (so keys change pitch), Keyboard "Gate" → ADSR's "Gate" (so keys trigger the envelope), ADSR "Out" → VCA's "CV" (so the envelope shapes volume), and route the audio through the VCA: VCF "Out" → VCA's "In", VCA "Out" → Output's "In". Press and hold a computer key (A, S, D…) and you should hear a note fade in and out, instead of a constant drone.
